# Code of Conduct

CinderMed adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) as its code of conduct. It applies to every project space (repositories, issues, pull requests, discussions) and to anyone representing the project in public spaces.

In short: be respectful and inclusive, accept constructive criticism, focus on what is best for the community, and do not harass, insult or publish others' private information.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to an owner of the [CinderMed organization](https://github.com/CinderMed). All reports are reviewed promptly and fairly, and the reporter's privacy is respected.

## Enforcement

The maintainers apply the Contributor Covenant 2.1 enforcement guidelines: correction, warning, temporary ban and permanent ban, depending on the impact of the behaviour.
